segment_captions.caption: A car drives down a winding road, emitting smoke from its rear. Two individuals stand on the side of the road, observing the scene. The landscape features dry grass and scattered trees under a clear sky.

A car drives down a dirt road, kicking up dust behind it. Two people stand on the side of the road, observing the vehicle. The car continues driving away from the camera, leaving a trail of dust in its wake.
A car drives along a dirt road, kicking up dust behind it. A person stands near a signpost, observing the vehicle's passage.
A car speeds past, kicking up dust as spectators watch from the roadside. The dust cloud billows behind the vehicle, obscuring part of the road and the surrounding landscape.
A dust cloud rises from the ground as people walk along a fence line in a dry, grassy area. The dust cloud grows larger and more prominent as it spreads across the scene.
